newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower, lacks fireworks.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower, lacks fireworks.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Friday but lacked any of Thursday's fireworks when prices fell sharply on the back of the French crop forecast.
At close of business on Friday wheat futures were 0.50 to 0.05 stg down after trading 560 lots.
Barley finished 0.65 to 0.10 stg down after trading 45 lots.
In the Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract closed two marks down after trading five lots.
"The market tried to rally early in the day but failed with the result that there has been very little trade," said a trader.
On the fob market Oct/Dec traded at 110.25 stg and Jan/Mar at 112.75 stg a tonne fob ex-east coast ports.
Traders said there were sellers 0.25 stg below the traded levels, but not a bid in sight.
Delivered trade was also slow with feed wheat fetching 112.50 stg in the Liverpool area and 110.50 stg in the Avon range.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 132 stg for Sep in Liverpool and 126 stg in London.
Feed barley in East Anglia was trading around 106 stg for Oct/Dec.
